articles.full_text:
The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a red alert for heavy to very heavy rainfall conditions over West Bengal, Jharkhand, Telangana, Chhattisgarh, Coastal Andhra Pradesh and Odisha tomorrow. Heavy to very heavy rainfall conditions over Bihar, Vidarbha and Sikkim tomorrow.
The Weather Department has also predicted heavy rainfall over Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Assam, Meghalaya, East Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Mahe and Marathwada. IMD said that thundersquall with wind speed over Chhattisgarh, Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Odisha and Telangana are expected tomorrow. It also said that thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty over Goa, Maharashtra and Rayalaseema during the next three to four days. Similar Weather Conditions are also expected to prevail over Madhya Pradesh, Sub Himalayan, Sikkim Tamil Nadu and Puducherry for the same period.
